footer.facts: No cookies · No accounts · Open source

deleteModal.title: Delete Format
deleteModal.message: Are you sure you want to delete this custom format? This action cannot be undone.

editor.languageHelp_es: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, converting 'ñ' to 'ny', removing accents, and replacing slashes / with the word 'o') according to Spanish rules.
editor.languageHelp_en: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, removing accents, special symbols, and replacing slashes / with the word 'or') according to English standards.
editor.languageHelp_fr: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, removing accents like é, è, ç, and replacing slashes / with the word 'ou') according to French rules.
editor.languageHelp_de: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, converting 'ß' to 'ss', cleaning umlauts ä, ö, ü, and replacing slashes / with the word 'oder') according to German rules.
editor.languageHelp_it: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, removing accents from à, è, ì, ò, ù, and replacing slashes / with the word 'o') according to Italian rules.
editor.languageHelp_pt: Adapts character sanitization and formatting rules (for example, removing accents in á, ê, ç, and replacing slashes / with the word 'ou') according to Portuguese rules.

formats.title: Formats
formats.builtinNote: This format comes with the app and can't be changed. You can change its formatting language or clone it to edit the template and fields.
formats.templateHelp: Write each field between braces with its ID. Each field must appear once.
formats.warnUnknown: The template uses {tokens}, which match no field.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.message: This format has changes that are not saved. If you leave now, they will be lost.
